q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a yoga mat?
title: Yoga mat carbon footprint per mat
short: Weigh each mat and multiply by the supplier's figure for its material, such as PVC, TPE, NBR foam or natural rubber, then add the strap and pack. Add foaming, cutting and packing energy, then divide the plant's energy by mats made.

ul: PVC, TPE, NBR foam, EVA or natural rubber.
Jute or cotton backing in some mats.

p: Report per mat by material, thickness and weight.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per mat (one month)
lines: Plant total: 21,300 / 50,000 = 0.426 kg CO2 per mat
Add the mat material and pack for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
